n: 10 serial ports (RS232/RS485/422) supporting DMX512 (Central control host)
d: 10 serial ports (RS232/RS485/422) supporting DMX512, 8 infrared (IR) ports, 8 relay ports, 8 I/O ports, 1 bidirectional Ethernet port (capable of controlling UDP/TCP network devices externally), 1 NET port, 1 TF card slot, 11 status indicator LEDs, and 8 programmable buttons with user-definable functions.
